rationale: The proposed proposition succeeds at its stated diagnostic purpose: a total real function whose square equals every real input would have to square to a negative number, which is impossible, so the unrestricted ordinary-real p = 1/2 interpretation fails for negative values. That success does not make it equivalent to the source sentence. Relative to the printed moment and absolute-moment definitions, it is only a weaker obstruction consequence and omits their defining, probabilistic, and parameterized content.
